sources.title: Yeo Lab - UC San Diego
sources.text: YEO LAB This is the Yeo Lab, a hybrid computational and experimental RNA Biology, Neurobiology, and RNA Therapeutics lab at UC San Diego . Tell me more Major Themes We study post-transcriptional processing of RNAs by multiple mechanisms. RBPs as Regulators Examining How Defects in Protein-RNA Complexes Lead to Human Disease RBPs as Drug Targets Altering gene regulatory circuits in mammalian cells by manipulating RNA processing using modular assemblies of proteins or protein-RNA complexes RBPs as Therapies Learn More CONTACT US LAB LOCATION Sanford Consortium for Regenerative Medicine Room 3109-13, Wet Lab Room 3114/3115, Bioinformatics Lab Room 3007, Gene’s Office MAILING ADDRESS 2880 Torrey Pines Scenic Dr. Room 3109-13/Yeo Lab La Jolla, CA 92037 TELEPHONE (858) 246-1497, Wet Lab (858) 534-9322, Bioinformatics Lab
